product_metadata.title: Fun Express - British Party Garland for Party - Party Decor - Hanging Decor - Garland - Party - 1 Piece
features: Hang the Union Jack high at a British theme prom, homecoming, baby shower or birthday celebration. This British flag garland is a fun decoration for any Anglophile event. Spells out "Cheers." Material: Paper. Size: 90" long with eight 7" x 7" pennants.
